admission.justification: A tool call that failed after its client stopped waiting left no tool-log row, so a caller who checked afterwards could not learn whether or why the call failed.

applicability: Tool calls whose blocking work runs in a worker thread through run_in_request_thread or run_in_detached_request_thread.
conditions: The request is cancelled while the worker runs.
The worker then raises an exception.
exclusions: A worker that returns a result after the cancellation; the tool logs that result as usual.
Asynchronous handlers that run on the event loop.
A request cancelled before its worker starts, which leaves a cancelled row instead.
statement: When a blocking tool worker raises after its request was cancelled, the server logs the original raised error once with a cancellation marker and leaves ordinary result logging to the tool.
